verdict.rationale: incident.io documents several in-product AI features that generate insights and suggestions from the customer's own incident data. Suggestions automatically drafts updates, summaries and follow-up actions from incident activity. Postmortem AI produces first drafts, inline review suggestions and section redrafts. Investigations gathers alerts, past incidents, channel discussion, code changes and telemetry, then forms and tests root-cause hypotheses. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these AI insights work as claimed.
